title: Symptom-network dynamics in irritable bowel syndrome with comorbid panic disorder using electronic momentary assessment: A randomized controlled trial of escitalopram vs. placebo
limitations: - Small sample size; - High test burden of ESM leading to limited power; - Baseline differences between groups; - Multiple testing without correction; - Cannot correct for baseline differences in network analysis.
notes: The paper does not explicitly state whether code or data are publicly available. The authors mention that the data are from a clinical trial and may be subject to restrictions. The paper does not mention preregistration.
